name: 李嗣源
summary: id="Summary">Summary [ edit ] Description 唐明宗.jpg Title Xin juan Yu ming tang pi ping an jian can bu : Nan Song zhi zhuan shi juan, Bei Song zhi zhuan shi juan Other Title 新鐫玉茗堂批評按鑑參補 : 南宋志傳十卷, 北宋志傳十卷 / Nan Song zhi zhuan Nan Bei Song zhi zhuan Bei Song zhi zhuan Xiu xiang Nan Bei Song zhi zhuan Summary There are two sections: "The record of Southern Song" and "The record of Northern Song"; each section includes ten chapters and fifty parts. Contributor Names Yanshishanqiao, ding zheng. Shan cheng tang, ke. Chinese Rare Book Collection (Library of Congress). Created / Published [China] : Shan cheng tang, [Qing dai, between 1800 and 1912?] Subject Headings - Ji bu--Xiao shuo lei - 集部--小說類 Notes - Also available in digital form on the Library of Congress Web site. - November 24, 1950. - 十冊二函. Ten volumes in two cases. - 清善成堂刻本 四周單邊左右雙邊相間 白口 黑單魚尾 版匡高20.0寬13.2公分 全書高24.3寬15.7公分 . - 十二行二十四字. Twelve lines, with twenty-four characters per line. - 鈐印有："善成堂自在蘇杭浙閩檢選古今書籍發兌" 朱文長方印，"松琴文庫"朱文方印. - 函脊號191簽條號614. - 1950年11月24日入藏 (見書名葉，另有號碼2051 J, 印章6 Copy). - 函面題"南北宋志傳"，函脊題"南北宋志傳"，以"乾"，"坤"為序。函1，函2各含10冊。書名葉中間和左題"繡像南北宋志傳"，右上題"玉茗堂批點"，左下題"善成堂藏板". - 本書含南宋志傳和北宋志傳二種： 南宋志傳10卷50回，1函5冊；卷首額題"新鐫玉茗堂批評按鑑參補南宋志傳卷之一"，下署"研石山樵訂正"。版心上題"南宋志傳"，中題卷次及回數，下題每卷頁碼。冊1含織里畸人書於玉茗堂之《南宋志傳序》，總目，繡像6幅，卷1-2（第1-10回），冊2含卷3-4（第11-20回），冊3含卷5-6（第21-30回），冊4含卷7-8（第31-40回），冊5含卷9-10（第41-50回）。此書雖題南宋志傳，實為記述五代末趙匡胤建立北宋之小說. - 北宋志傳（卷内題楊家將志傳）： 10卷50回，1函5冊；本書另有書名葉，中間和左題"繡像楊家將志傳" ，右上題"玉茗堂批點"。卷首額題"新鐫玉茗堂批點按鑑參補楊家將卷之一"，下署"研石山樵訂正，啟元堂梓行"，卷2後改題"研石山樵訂正，織里畸人校閱"。版心上題"北宋志傳"，中題卷次及回數，下題每卷頁碼。冊1含玉茗主人萬曆46年（1618）之《北宋志傳序》，繡像6幅，總目，卷1-2（第1-10回）。冊2含卷3-4（第11-20回），冊3含卷5-6（第21-30回），冊4含卷7-8（第31-40回），冊5含卷9-10（第41-50回）. Medium 10 v. : ill. It might not load properly or could cause your browser to freeze when opened at full size. anonymous : Seated Portrait of Song Taizu     Artist Anonymous Unknown author Title Seated Portrait of Song Taizu Series title Portraits from the Nanxun Hall   Object type painting   Description English: This depicts Song Taizu (宋太祖, 927-976, reigned 960-976), personal name Zhao Kuangyin (趙匡胤), the first emperor of the Song dynasty. This painting has neither the painter's seal nor signature. However, a small label had been attached to a blank area at the arm rest with the three characters "Song Taizu" (宋太祖). It probably was added when the scroll was remounted in the Qing dynasty (1644-1911).
